description: This script is a utility for flashing firmware on D-Link DSL-G6x4T (Fritz!Box) devices. It performs network detection of the device via UDP broadcast, retrieves device information via FTP, and uploads firmware images to specific memory segments.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP customized for device-specific commands like getenv, check, reboot, and environment variable retrieval.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Send USER command over FTP, standardized for this device.

methods.name: _PASV
methods.description: Enter passive mode via custom command for device FTP transfer.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieve environment variable from the device via FTP.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables from device.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Send reboot command to the device.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Perform flash check on device memory partition.
